source_caption:
📺 The Exes (2011–2015)

The Exes follows three divorced men—Phil Chase, Haskell Lutz, and Stuart Gardner—who unexpectedly become roommates in a New York City apartment arranged by their divorce attorney and close friend, Holly Franklin. Despite having completely different personalities, the three men share one thing in common: they’re all trying to rebuild their lives after failed marriages. Phil is a confident ladies’ man who enjoys dating, Haskell is a sarcastic homebody who constantly finds himself in ridiculous situations, and Stuart is a sensitive dentist struggling to move on from his divorce. As the roommates navigate complicated romances, awkward dates, friendship problems, and hilarious misunderstandings, Holly frequently finds herself helping them deal with their chaotic personal lives. Starring Donald Faison, Wayne Knight, David Alan Basche, Kristen Johnston, and Kelly Stables, the series delivers unforgettable comedy, entertaining characters, and heartwarming moments while exploring friendship, relationships, second chances, and the challenges of starting over.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Romance • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Mark Reisman

📺 Seasons: 4 • 64 Episodes

📚 Setting: New York City

source_details.synopsis: The Exes is an American sitcom starring Donald Faison, Wayne Knight, David Alan Basche, Kelly Stables and Kristen Johnston. It debuted on TV Land on November 30, 2011, airing on Wednesday nights at 10:30 p.m. The series was created by Mark Reisman and follows three divorced men who live in a New York City apartment owned by their divorce lawyer. In February 2014, TV Land renewed the series for a twelve-episode fourth season that premiered on November 5, 2014. Additional episodes were ordered before the season premiered.
